notes: Shipped competitor bug: a mid-session ABR rendition switch reset the player and silently lost the subtitle selection because it depended on transient session state. The resolver is a pure function of (tracks, prefs, audioTrackLang, pin) with no session-local memory, so a rendition-switch re-negotiation (encoded here as a second identical resolve) must reproduce a byte-identical selection and reason every time. Conformance runners for this case MUST resolve the input twice and assert both results equal this fixture's expected output.
